title: Vincent Van Gogh, a Great Dutch Painter
passage:
Vincent Van Gogh was a great Dutch painter, and these days everybody wants to be an owner of one of his pieces of art. When any of them come up for sale, they often go for millions of dollars. That wasn't always the case though. When Van Gogh was still alive, very few people knew his name, nor was his art appreciated. He and his precious works only became famous after his death at the age of 37.

Vincent Van Gogh was one of the greatest Dutch painters. He used strong colors in his work. Two of his most well-known works are Sunflowers and The Starry Night. The latter even inspired a singer to write a song about the artist.

Besides his art, people often bring up other things when having a conversation about Van Gogh. They usually talk about his mental state. He wasn't in his right mind, and he spent some time in mental hospitals. Van Gogh cut off his left ear after he argued with another artist. He even created works about it after. Though he was considered crazy, Van Gogh produced wonderful art that we still enjoy today.
